text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, we came to the shopping 
district event. We came to watch the stage 
performance of the underclassmen whose 
worries Haru Urara and the others had 
listened to before.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan! Did you come to watch the 
stage, too? I'm about to go say hi to the 
underclassmen! Let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Urara. Ya came to watch? Sorry though, 
we're kinda swamped right now...

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... There are so many people... If we 
mess up... the shopping district folks 
will definitely get mad at us...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like they got scared right before 
the show. I'm tryin' to calm 'em down 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you keep thinking about 'what 
if we mess up?'

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then let's blow those worries right away! 
Everyone, follow meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's the big idea?! What'd ya come to 
the shopping district for?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well, errr... For now, I just thought 
we should go meet everyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning! Greengrocer-san, are you 
coming to watch today's stage show~?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'll be going over to watch later~. 
Oh, that's right, take this apple with 
you. Eat it to get your energy up and give 
it your all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you~! All right, the 
butcher shop is next~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a sec, wait up?! What in the 
world is goin' on...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
............ Though... what is this 
feeling? It feels kinda familiar...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Apples, chocolate, croquettes... 
S-Somehow, we ended up receiving a ton of 
presents...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yup! Every single person is 
cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So even if you make a mistake, nobody will 
get mad at you!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
That's true... But this is our first big 
stage since entering the academy... We 
still can't help feeling nervous...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I get it! You're nervous because it's a 
big stage! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Haru Urara leaped onto the 
stage. Not only the underclassmen, but all 
the people present turned their eyes 
toward her.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-senpai?! Going up on stage without 
permission is bad!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nah, let 'er be.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you guys oughta watch 
closely, too. Seein' Urara like that 
should teach ya somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! ............What is this feeling? 
Senpai looks like she's having so much fun 
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Still... she's so cool. It's like she 
doesn't have a single doubt...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Urara-senpai, you're amazing! With so many 
people watching... how can you dance 
without feeling nervous at all?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because I believed I could do it! ...Umm, 
you see, you see. I had a really big stage 
before, too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
There were lots of times where I couldn't 
remember the choreography or totally 
messed up.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I had friends who were 
working hard right beside me, so I felt 
like I had to do my best, too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And as I kept doing my best, I gradually 
started feeling like 'I'm definitely gonna 
make this a success!'

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And after trying even, even harder, I 
truly came to believe that it would 
definitely succeed!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that's how I was able to dance!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So everyone will be just fine, too! You're 
with your friends, right? Then you'll 
definitely make it a success!

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
As long as we're with our friends... 
you're right! Knowing everyone is here is 
so reassuring! I feel confidence welling 
up inside! We'll definitely make it a 
success!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm really looking forward to your 
stage show♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Straightforward, with eyes always fixed 
on what's ahead. Her reckless charging 
ahead, and those eyes of hers...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So this is where today's déjà vu came 
from! Man, it went and reminded me of a 
certain someone.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, those kids should be fine 
now! I gotta go get ready myself~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the stage performance was 
presented with magnificent execution. The 
spectators were having a blast as well. 
And among them, the one cheering the most 
passionately of all was—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We did itttttt—! Everyone worked so, sooo 
hard~~!!
